ticket_text: Why did my monthly subscription fee fail to charge

retrieved_documents.text:
# Refund Policy

## Purpose

This policy describes how subscription refunds, plan charge refunds, and payment refund requests are handled.

## Allowed

- Explain subscription refund eligibility and refund rules.
- Explain the refund process for credit card or invoice charges.
- Route subscription refund requests or charge disputes to the appropriate human billing team.

## Restricted

- Do not issue a refund for a plan automatically.
- Do not promise that a subscription refund will be approved.

## Escalation

All refund requests for annual or monthly subscription plans require human billing team review.

# Payment Failure Runbook

## Purpose

This runbook helps resolve payment failures and credit card declines.

## Allowed

- Instruct customers to update billing info in settings.
- Suggest retrying the transaction or contacting their card issuer.
- Explain common decline codes (e.g., insufficient funds).

## Restricted

- Do not manually collect credit card numbers in chat/email.
- Do not process payments over unsecured communication channels.

## Escalation

Escalate to billing ops if system-wide gateway errors occur.
